title: Garage Door Equipment Inspection Report Form
subtitle: Control inspection, stored-energy control, repair, balance, safety testing, and release through verified identity, domain-specific observations, evidence, authorization, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original, workflow-complete garage door service equipment inspection report for doors, tracks, springs, cables, operators, controls, and safety devices. It connects manufacturer information and approved safety scope to present conditions, repeatable evidence, decisions, unresolved work, and the receiving party's handoff.
use_case: Use when a qualified garage-door service technician must inspect doors, tracks, springs, cables, operators, controls, and safety devices against stated criteria and issue a traceable condition, restriction, corrective-action, or release decision.

sections.title: Garage Door inspection scope, criteria, and readiness
sections.guidance: Do not infer whole-asset or whole-site condition from a limited, inaccessible, or unqualified inspection.

blocks.label: Inspection access and control readiness
items: Door, operator, remotes, and controls isolated against unexpected movement
Torsion, extension, counterbalance, and suspended-door energy controlled
People, pets, vehicles, and property cleared from the door path
Door weight supported before spring, cable, roller, track, or bracket work
Ladder, lift, tool, winding-bar, and access method appropriate and inspected
Structural attachments, header, track supports, and fasteners assessed
Photoelectric, edge, force, reversal, release, and control functions preserved
Replacement spring, cable, roller, hardware, and operator compatibility verified
Customer remotes and access features controlled during testing
Full balance and entrapment-protection test plan completed before release

Photoelectric sensors, edge device, wiring, alignment, and obstruction response

Header, framing, ceiling attachment, vehicle clearance, and surrounding property

sections.title: Garage Door equipment inspection report closeout and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when outcome, remaining limitation, next action, evidence, and receiving ownership agree.

blocks.label: Final outcome, handoff, and record location
Record boundary and stop condition
blocks.guidance: This garage door service equipment inspection report is an operational record, not a substitute for applicable law, licensing, product labeling, manufacturer instructions, site policy, safety requirements, or professional judgment. Stop affected work, access, application, operation, testing, or release when spring, cable, door support, operator, entrapment protection, balance, structural attachment, electrical, or controlled-energy condition is uncertain. A garage-door safety supervisor must review the exception, authorize the controlling decision, and preserve its evidence before closeout.
